information.ownPlan: exact preview of intended player action/destination/strike target before commit
information.opponent: enemy behavior family is visible before commitment; exact per-unit commitment remains sealed until simultaneous resolution

PRESS.description: close distance aggressively; strike when adjacent

CONTROL.description: protect objective space; brace on/near objective and otherwise reposition toward it

resolution.moveCollision: all units contesting the same destination remain at origin
resolution.strike: strike targets the nearest orthogonally adjacent opponent at commitment time; it hits only if that target remains in the targeted cell after movement
resolution.brace: negates one incoming strike and holds position
resolution.advance: one step by Manhattan distance toward the objective, preferring vertical progress then horizontal
resolution.flank: one horizontal step toward the objective column; if already aligned, one horizontal step away from the board center using deterministic tie-break

boundary: This is the already-declared T03 clean throwaway carrier. It removes Station Zero delegation/Agent/dashboard machinery and does not add a new product mechanism after seeing results.
